lead.headline: The champ went shopping in a rival’s trash
lead.dek: Maye I touch your TDs? claimed Jacoby Brissett, the quarterback Bad things man bad things cut a week ago, and turned a two-QB problem into a 60% shot at AB81.
lead.pull: One man’s waiver drop is another man’s playoff push.
body: Brock Purdy’s bye left this team with one healthy quarterback in a league that starts two. That’s not a lineup problem. That’s a forfeit with extra steps. So at 12:10 a.m. Wednesday the front office fixed it, claiming Jacoby Brissett off waivers.

You may remember Brissett. Bad things man bad things dropped him eight days ago for Bryce Young, and he spent Week 7 throwing a touchdown to Bad things man bad things’ own tight end. Now he’s the best quarterback on the waiver wire, projected for 18.68, and he plays for the defending champion.
Then came the cleanup. Brissett’s claim cost the kicker, Ka’imi Fairbairn, so at 7:24 a.m. Wednesday the champ added Matt Gay and let Woody Marks, on bye, go. Two moves, one morning, problem solved.

The payoff: with both teams’ best available lineups, Maye I touch your TDs? projects for 159.81 to AB81’s 149.28, a 60% favorite. For a team sitting in the last playoff spot at 77.7% odds, against a 6-1 team the luck numbers say is playing over its head, this is the kind of week that decides a season.
AB81 is still the most dangerous record in the league. But the champ is acting like the champ again. Last year’s title ran on the waiver wire, and the waiver wire is open.

quick_hits.headline: Big Stric Energy covered every bye before Thursday
quick_hits.body: Chase McLaughlin on waivers at 12:10 a.m. Wednesday, the Jacksonville defense at 6:23 p.m. Wednesday. Projected 157.42 to 139.46 over Santa Clara’s Finest, a 67% favorite. Six-game losing streaks have to end somewhere.

quick_hits.headline: The add of the day is Saquon Barkley’s backup
quick_hits.body: Elijah Mitchell is the most-added player on Sleeper over the last 24 hours, 794,097 adds, and he’s available in R.A.T.S. Saquon Barkley is Questionable and on the Big Stric Energy roster.

quick_hits.headline: Sleeper is dumping Poochinski’s bench
quick_hits.body: The three most-dropped players on Sleeper are Dameon Pierce, Roschon Johnson and Tyler Higbee. All three are on the Poochinski roster. Pierce alone was cut 865,840 times in a day. Four moves all season says they’re staying put.

quick_hits.headline: Lob City reloaded its kicker and defense
quick_hits.body: The Cincinnati defense (projected 9.85) and Evan McPherson (7.75) came in on waivers at 12:10 a.m. Wednesday. Bad things man bad things projects for 152.9 against Poochinski’s 169.23.

quick_hits.headline: The closest game of the week is a coin flip
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins projects for 148.65 and Cherry Blossom for 146.24. A 52% favorite and a 48% underdog that rank second and fourth in points, separated by less than a field goal.

w8-m1.headline: The 1-6 Bowl
w8-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy has the better roster this week, 157.42 to 139.46 at full strength, and already patched its byes. The loser sinks another game toward the basement and can start planning for next year.

w8-m2.headline: First place, highest ceiling
w8-m2.blurb: Poochinski projects for 169.23, the best number in the league this week. Bad things man bad things needs a quarterback answer with C.J. Stroud and Tyler Shough both on bye. 65% Poochinski.

w8-m3.headline: Two teams better than their records
w8-m3.blurb: deeboliciouskins 148.65, Cherry Blossom 146.24. Christian McCaffrey’s bye is most of the gap. Coin flip with a slight lean.

w8-m4.headline: The champ needed a QB. The champ got a QB.
w8-m4.blurb: With Brissett in, Maye I touch your TDs? projects for 159.81 to 149.28. AB81 is 6-1 and 99.9% to make the playoffs; the champ is fighting for the last spot. That’s the difference in urgency.
